title: Partner-result integration harness: environment, fixture keys, answer shapes, same-day cut-off, evidence and gate are not specified
source: 22 Microservice Realignment/Recovery Workbench Microservice Story Template and Rules v1.md §R7.3 and §R9; _work/msr/wp/B-ITG-W4-06.md; 04 User stories/Recovery Workbench User Stories Epics 3 to 8 v3.md RWB-E6-033 lines 12148-12227
description: RWB-ITG-E6033-ITG needs the SIT environment and base hosts, the fixture layout, the synthetic partner, instruction and case keys, the result reference and the answer shape of the result submission, the same-day cut-off that decides whether the attachment is same-day, the evidence format and its retention, and the pass or fail gate at the wave entry check. No source gives any of them, so one placeholder is used in sections 3, 12.8, 13 and 15.
evidence: Legacy RWB-E6-033 (User Stories Epics 3 to 8 v3, lines 12148-12227) names the two partner-portal operations, the five data entities, SCR-34 and SCR-35, the permission checks and TC-E6-033-01 to TC-E6-033-04, and states no environment, fixture, key scheme, answer shape, cut-off, evidence format or gate; Epics 3 to 8 Specification v3 line 138 (FEAT-PRM-05) and Business Requirements Program v4 lines 433 and 437 (REQ-S9-004, REQ-S9-008) name the outcome and the channel but no harness detail; Business Rules and Routing Logic v4 line 364 (R-WO-33) says 'same day' and defines no cut-off; Arch v5 slide 17 (lines 1243-1256 and 1270-1272), slide 41 (line 2891) and slide 43 row 21 (line 2947) give the contract and the event and no harness configuration; Template and Rules v1 §R7.3 lists the fill order and none of its sources holds these values.
proposed: Agree at the wave 4 entry check the SIT base hosts, the fixture layout and the synthetic key scheme, the result reference and answer shape, the same-day cut-off, the evidence format and retention, and the pass or fail gate, and record them in the harness README; the fixture values stay data and no business value is hard-coded.

title: Harness environment and base hosts, fixture layout, synthetic keys, complaint outcome and reason codes, evidence-pack answer shape, evidence format and retention, and the pass or fail gate for the X1 dispute and complaint harness are not specified
source: Legacy story RWB-E7-001 sections 11 to 16 of 04 User stories/Recovery Workbench User Stories Epics 3 to 8 v3.md, lines 10972 to 11019; FEAT-DVF-01, Epics 3 to 8 Specification v3 line 124; REQ-S8-003, Business Requirements Program v4 line 419; Template and Rules v1 R7.2 and R9; WP B-ITG-W4-06
section: 3 Preconditions; 12.8 Contract fakes; 13 Solution plan; 15 Screens and states; 16 Test cases
description: No source gives the environment and base hosts the X1 harness runs against, the layout of its fixture, the synthetic case, deviation and complaint keys it uses, the complaint outcome and reason codes that R-DEV-09 records, the shape of the P5 documents answer that carries the complaint evidence pack, the evidence format and its retention, or the pass or fail gate that accepts the wave. The legacy story names two screens and four messages and no harness, and the Ownership Map names the owners of deviation, recovery_case, timer, document, decision_log_entry and rule_row and no harness artefact. The story therefore writes the placeholder and the assumption ASM-B-ITG-W4-06-E7001-1 wherever these values sit.
evidence: RWB-E7-001 gives the deviation, timer, decision_log_entry and rule_row entities with their DF ranges, the two deviation endpoints, SCR-06 and SCR-08 and the four messages, and no environment, no fixture, no synthetic key, no outcome code, no evidence artefact and no gate; the Architecture v5 extract names gateway-bff as the only staff entry and DP-19 as the composite route and gives neither a route path nor a merge order; ownership.json lists the owners of the deviation, case, timer, document, decision and access operations and no harness.
proposed: The integration lead and the QA lead agree the harness base hosts and the fixture layout, fix the synthetic case, deviation and complaint keys and the outcome and reason codes as fixture data with the R-DEV-09 and R-DEV-20 values, pin the P5 documents answer as metadata only, fix the evidence as one report per story and case_no with the pre-flag snapshot beside the post-clear read and one row per criterion, hop and timer, retain it with the release record, and agree the gate as every owned criterion green with RWB-S8-E7001-APP in place and every hop either the owner or a stub named as a stub.

title: Legacy AC2 cites the X6 lost-contact rule R-DEV-17 on an X2 vulnerability and hardship case
source: 04 User stories/Recovery Workbench User Stories Epics 3 to 8 v3.md lines 11048-11052; _work/msr/extract/Recovery Workbench Business Rules and Routing Logic v4.md line 399
section: 7 Acceptance criteria; 8 Business rules; 16 Test cases; 18 Traceability
description: Legacy AC2 of RWB-E7-002 is titled 'Rule R-DEV-17' and reads 'Given a case in state DEV_WITH_OWNER / When contact not found / Then route to escalation or to the route decision / Then the case moves to DEV_REROUTE'. R-DEV-17 is the X6 lost-contact rule (deviation_code = X6 and skip trace exhausted, CONTACT_NOT_FOUND) and belongs to FEAT-DVF-06, not to X2. The published X2 rules are R-DEV-03 (assign the specialist), R-DEV-10 (X2 resolved routes to the restructure assessment, DEV_REROUTE) and R-DEV-19 (reopen the route decision, ROUTE_D6). The harness does not assert R-DEV-17 on an X2 case. Legacy AC2 stays with RWB-S8-E7002-APP as a build criterion and its rule citation is recorded here as a conflict; TC-E7-002-02-ITG asserts the published X2 path instead under ITG AC4.
evidence: Legacy RWB-E7-002 AC2 lines 11048-11052; R-DEV-17 row line 399 (X6, CONTACT_NOT_FOUND, skip trace exhausted); R-DEV-03 line 385; R-DEV-10 line 392; R-DEV-19 line 401; Temporal and Drools design slide 24 line 1652 names X2 vulnerability/hardship to the specialist and X6 lost contact to the agent.
area: S8 deviation handling, X2 route rules
owner_role: Center of excellence with S8 rwb-deviation
proposed: Keep legacy AC2 with RWB-S8-E7002-APP as a build criterion, assert only R-DEV-03, R-DEV-10 and R-DEV-19 on X2 in this harness, correct the AC2 rule citation when RWB-S8-E7002-APP is refreshed, and keep R-DEV-17 with the X6 story RWB-S8-E7006-APP.

title: Harness environment, fixture, vulnerable-customer contact-limit values, evidence format and gate are not specified
source: 22 Microservice Realignment/Recovery Workbench Microservice Story Template and Rules v1.md R9; _work/msr/extract/Recovery Workbench Business Rules and Routing Logic v4.md line 410; Business Requirements Program v4 line 418
section: 3 Preconditions; 12.8 Contract fakes; 13 Solution plan; 15 Screens and states; 17 Guardrails
description: No source names the ITG harness environment and base hosts, the fixture layout, the synthetic case, deviation and treatment keys, the stub answer shapes, the evidence format and retention, or the pass or fail gate. Separately, R-UNI-06 requires the vulnerable customer treatment rules to be applied and REQ-S8-002 requires the contact limits set for the case, but no source publishes the limit values (number of contacts, channels, hours or period). The values are held as fixture and parameter data only, never in code.
evidence: R-UNI-06 line 410 says 'Raise X2, apply the vulnerable customer treatment rules' with no values; REQ-S8-002 line 418 says 'follows the contact limits set for it' with no values; the Business Rules and Routing Logic v4 has no contact-limit rule row; the Epics 3 to 8 Specification v3 FEAT-DVF-02 row (line 125) names no limit.
area: ITG harness configuration, fixture and contact-limit parameters
owner_role: QA lead with the Center of excellence
proposed: Fix the environment, fixture, evidence format, retention and gate at the wave entry check and hold the contact limits as P3 parameter data; the harness reads them from the fixture and fails the run if a limit is written in code.

title: Legacy X3 acceptance criterion AC3 cites R-DEV-06, a rule the published X3 branch does not use
source: Recovery Workbench User Stories Epics 3 to 8 v3, RWB-E7-003 AC3, lines 11145 to 11149; Recovery Workbench Business Rules and Routing Logic v4, lines 385, 388, 393 and 394
description: Legacy AC3 is an X3 scenario (DEV_FLAGGED, owner assigned, DEV_WITH_OWNER) but its rule id is R-DEV-06, which the published rule table applies to X6 and X7 with the text 'Agent handles within policy; a person approves an insurance claim'. The published X3 branch is R-DEV-11 (insurance clears the balance, close the case, CASE_ENDED) and R-DEV-12 (insurance does not clear, return to the route decision against the estate, DEV_REROUTE), with R-DEV-03 for the assignment to the specialist and Legal. The harness therefore cannot assert R-DEV-06 on an X3 case, and it does not invent an approval step that the published X3 branch does not have.
evidence: Business Rules and Routing Logic v4 line 385 R-DEV-03 (deviation_code in X2,X3: assign to the specialist, Legal joins X3 for the estate claim); line 388 R-DEV-06 (deviation_code in X6,X7: agent handles within policy, a person approves an insurance claim); line 393 R-DEV-11 (X3 and insurance clears the balance: close the case, CASE_ENDED); line 394 R-DEV-12 (X3 and insurance does not clear: return to the route decision against the estate, DEV_REROUTE); legacy AC3 lines 11145 to 11149.
owner_role: S8 rwb-deviation product owner with the rule owner in rwb-decision
proposed: Keep legacy AC3 verbatim in RWB-S8-E7003-APP as its build criterion and correct its rule id there to R-DEV-03 with R-DEV-11 and R-DEV-12 as the two outcomes. In this harness the legacy AC3 text is carried by TC-E7-003-03-ITG but the run asserts R-DEV-11 (AC4) and R-DEV-12 (AC5) and no approval step. R-DEV-06 stays with the X6 and X7 harness stories.

title: Harness environment, fixture, insurer and estate answer shapes, heir-notification content, evidence format and gate are not published
source: WP B-ITG-W4-06; FSD S8 v3 (no harness section); Architecture v5 slides 15 and 41 to 44 (contracts and events only, no test environment); Template and Rules v1 §R7.2 s13
description: No source states where the X3 integration harness runs and on which base hosts, how the fixture and the synthetic case, deviation, document and claim keys are laid out, what shape the insurer answer and the estate position take, what the heir notification contains and whether the harness asserts it, how the evidence is formatted and how long it is kept, or what verdict the wave entry check accepts. The story uses the placeholder in sections 3, 12.8, 13 and 15 and continues in Draft.
evidence: Template and Rules v1 §R7.2 s13 treats environment, build steps and Done when as story content; §R9 requires the placeholder where no source has the value; FSD S8 v3 and Architecture v5 name the contracts and the AceDataReady deceased flag but not a harness, fixture or gate.
owner_role: QA lead with the integration lead
proposed: Agree at the wave entry check: SIT and the base hosts, the fixture layout and the synthetic keys, the insurer and estate answer shapes, whether the heir notification is asserted or only held in the fixture, the evidence format and retention, and a gate in which a stub pass is never a real pass.

title: X4 integration harness environment, fixture and evidence are unspecified
source: WP B-ITG-W4-06; legacy RWB-E7-004; Epics 3 to 8 Specification v3 INT-31 (line 240)
description: The sources do not specify the X4 harness environment or base hosts, the fixture layout, the synthetic case, deviation and referral keys, the Aric referral answer shape and status vocabulary, the investigation tracking evidence, the evidence format and retention, or the pass or fail gate.
